ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low contrast ratio; visible surface is dominated by low-intensity dark pixels (near-black) with high-intensity pixels limited to extreme distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Wide V-shaped depression with a calculated angle of approximately 120 degrees at the central axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Low-amplitude, high-frequency irregular serrations visible along the linear boundary of the left lobe's trailing edge; right lobe trailing edge is partially obscured by water splash.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curve fitted to the trailing edges of both lobes, terminating in tapered, pointed tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized high-contrast white pixel clusters (approximately 5-10 pixels in diameter) concentrated on the extreme distal tips of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinct reddish-pink high-saturation pixel clusters at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right fluke lobes, indicating tissue exposure or parasitic lesions.
